editorial.blurb: Hai Yen is a no-frills Argyle mainstay serving deeply flavorful Vietnamese pho and banh mi with fresh ingredients and generous portions at budget-friendly prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Hawaiian leaf sausage banh mi or rice paper rolls—multiple reviewers called it a must-have—and consider dipping your banh mi into a bowl of their renowned beef pho for an unforgettable bite.
signatureDishes: Hawaiian leaf sausage rice paper rolls
